statements.impact_statement: OpenSSH host key handling use-after-free. The restic image carries the ssh client binaries in its alpine layer; our jobs use an S3 repository (no sftp backend) and never run ssh.
statements.action_statement: Re-check on restic 0.19.2 (the image was last built 2026-07-05; no fixed tag exists). Drop this statement once a fixed tag is pinned.

statements.impact_statement: Go crypto/tls session resumption in the kustomize binary bundled in the toolbox image. Our Jobs run kubectl, jq and curl, never kustomize.
statements.action_statement: Re-check on the next alpine/k8s tag (1.36.5 and 1.37.1 are the latest); consider a minimal kubectl image so unused tools are not shipped.

statements.impact_statement: PyJWT public key handling, pulled in by barman-cloud's Azure authentication path. We archive WAL to S3 and never configure Azure; nothing verifies a JWT with it.
statements.action_statement: No newer plain 18.x/16.x tag exists. Evaluate the -standard-trixie variant by a scan before the expiry.

statements.impact_statement: certifi bundles emSign roots whose intermediate CA keys leaked (fixed in certifi 2026.10.19). It is a dependency of Python tools in the toolbox image; our Jobs run kubectl, jq and curl, which use the system CA store, and never start Python.
statements.action_statement: Re-check on the next alpine/k8s tag (none carries certifi 2026.10.19 yet).

statements.impact_statement: grpc-go authorization bypass through a malformed :path matters to servers with path-based authorization interceptors; istiod and the CNI plugin use none. The line is past upstream support.
statements.action_statement: Replace by the Istio 1.31 upgrade (fixed in 1.29.10, 1.30.7, 1.31.3); this waiver ends with it and matches the end-of-support calendar.

statements.impact_statement: Go crypto/tls session resumption, mesh-internal mTLS only (xDS port, not published). The line is past upstream support.
statements.action_statement: Replace by the Istio 1.31 upgrade (fixed in 1.29.10, 1.30.7, 1.31.3); this waiver ends with it and matches the end-of-support calendar.
